WingFoil-Version: 0.3.1 (unknown)

Give each task a unique id

Tasks now carry an id, issued by the list when a task is added and
kept when it is renamed. The list gets get(id); find, complete, reopen,
rename, tag, untag and remove accept an id as well as a title. Ids are
never reissued, even after a task is removed.
